title: Types
description: The nine types a market's fields are, as a listing, a review, a vouch or a report holds their values. An entry holds only whole numbers, so numbers, money and coordinates are decimal text. build/README.md says what a program does with each.

number.description: A number, written as decimal text, such as "3" or "2.5". Filtered by range.

words.description: A list of short words. Filtered by them.

choice.description: One of the values the market lists for the field. Filtered by it.

place.description: A point and a radius in whole kilometres, and the area's name if wanted. Radius 0 is that exact spot; otherwise the place is somewhere in the circle, or anywhere in it the person will go. Two places match when their circles touch. A point is rough unless the radius is 0: give an exact point only for a public spot meant to be found, such as a court or a shop, and anywhere else a rough one with the real spot inside the circle, never a home's door.

lat.description: The point's latitude in degrees, decimal text from -90 to 90.

lon.description: The point's longitude in degrees, decimal text from -180 to 180.

radiusKm.description: The circle's radius round the point, in whole kilometres: 0 for that exact spot.

area.description: The name people know the area by, such as a town, a district or a court, which an index shows and finds the place by.

money.description: An amount of one currency, and what it is for. Printed and sorted by.

currency.description: A three-letter currency code, such as USD.

per.description: What the amount is for, one of the per values its field lists, such as hour. Absent: the whole deal.

moment.description: A time, or a span from one time to another, in RFC 3339 with its zone. Filtered by time.

file.description: One of the files its entry names, by the SHA-256 of its bytes in lowercase hex. The entry lists that file in files, as the standard names a file, so the folder's hosts keep its bytes. Fetched and shown.

hours.description: When a person is free, every week: slots on weekdays, in one time zone. Filtered by day and time.

zone.description: The time zone the times are in, by its name, such as Europe/Madrid.

days.description: The weekdays the slot is on.
